episodes.title: From cult-member to cult exit-counselor: Joseph Szimhart on belief and critical thinking.
episodes.description:
Belief Systems Episode 2 

A former member of a doomsday cult called The Church Universal and Triumphant, Joseph Szimhart has spent over 40 years working to help people leave similar groups.  During our conversation, Joe and I discussed his time in The Church Universal and Triumphant, his adventures as an exit counselor, and some of his insights into the world of cults.

Host: @DylanCroll , author of The Wayword Newsletter on Substack.
